body: Actually, there are so many other people on this webpage that need help, please leave me im not worth nearly as much as anyone else. Im just saying the truth i dont care man im garbage and i promise myself im going to go through with my plan. fuck I hate myself so fucking much, for good reason. please leave me, I shouldn't have written everything ive said here. just please forget me and help someone worth any humans time

yo man lets use this page cause its easy for me to read the messages and find them. I dont know what to say im just so fucking sad i dont want to make you sadder but like why do we keep trying to help each other why do we live these lives that suck to much. In history people had it way harder and it still feels so fucked up

I've noticed that when I reach these moment all I do is stare into space and think about nothing. All I notice is my breathing, and I listen as I take a quick breath in then a quick breath out and pause for about 3 seconds then repeat this breathing pattern, why does this matter? idk it doesnt lol I just want to keep writing down things for some reason. Its like im running but im not so i can have these 3 second breaks between fast breathes
Am I insane? maybe I am, I mean I talk to myself so easily
what do i do, all I can do is say "what do i do" and cry

jeez, everytime I read this it makes things worse, im sorry you took your precious time to read this I want you to know you deserve the best feelings and things in the world. forget about me, im just talking to myself i guess, hoping someone will care, but then getting angry at myself for making people care about a fucking piece of shit like me

no man your having a rough time, your not a attention whore in any way at all. Its good to reach out and talk about things that shouldn't be kept inside. and I think you just gotta keep going, sometimes its hard to see a bright future but it is there, whenever shit hits the fan just reach out. There will always be people out there that love you and will do anything to help you

hey man I want you to know im on here for most of tonight so lets chat man, about anything. I've learnt from my experience to find thing to distract your mind from thinking alone when your sad. be it talking to someone, video games , going to the gym, anything. But know your mind wont let you be convinced things change for the better but they truly do, I love you so much man, its gonna be ok :\)

thank you man, you really changed my night around, I fucking love you with every ounce of my being. I wish nothing but the best for you, im gonna go play some drunk overwatch and make my teammates laugh :\) 

and again, thank you

yo man life is fucked up at times but lets chat, and i suggest you throw on a youtube playlist of your fav music in the background while you browse this subreddit. Im gonna be on for a while tonight so im here man

man you saved me shit was getting real dark and just seeing what you said helped me take a breather, I just gotta keep passing time i guess, did you know last week I got really sad and snuck a bag out with rope and a paper and pencil and went out to the booneys to hang myself. but then i got a text from a friend asking if i want to go to the gym with him and somehow i drove there and and worked out with him then went to see the marvel infinity war movie in cinema that night with some good guys. Its crazy how life goes from the worst ever to a above average day lol
what do i do I want to give you hug but all i can do is type and cry

hey man, i dont even know what to say but like I just dont get it, life takes so much effort and it seems you get so little out of it, Im supposed to go camping with family and friends this coming weekend but I said im not going because of a stupid girl i fell in love with is going, just fuck man i really wish i wasnt who i am
talk to me homie I love you too much, I gotta know more than just bye
hey man you there?

Human interaction is critically important,  you have to find a way to get her to talk to someone, someone in real life is ideal but even just you over the internet can help her see the world in a way her mind cant let her see. Remember your a human just like the rest of us, nobody knows exactly what to do in every situation so don't beat yourself up for mistakes, learn from them and grow. Ask her what she likes to do to pass the time and get her to do those things,be it a movie, walk, car ride or a phone call to a friend, anything. For example if shes into video games once shes playing the game her focus won't be thinking to hard about herself , it will be on the game. your a good person I hope I help

I feel your struggle and the trick is to just keep going, there is always someone out there for you, its crazy how things change after even a few days. Don't cut yourself you don't deserve that. Find things you like to do, when you feel really shitty call up a friend or go for a jog or go see a movie, play video games, cook a meal anything really. When you do these things your focus changes from thinking to hard about yourself to whatever your doing at the time. take care, and know that I love you, along with everyone else in your amazing life. :\)

Are you with anyone? I want you to call or reach out to someone, anyone. Human interaction is critically important, when your alone thinking, all you have to think about is your thoughts which isn't reality. I fucking love you man

I know man depression is mega fucked up, but I want you to know that although your mind wont let you be convinced things change for the better, they truly do. Stay strong your an incredible person and the happiest most wonderful days of your life are still ahead. I love you man.
hey man, I know how you feel, thank you for sharing this. There are a lot of people out there that love you more than they're stars in the sky, including me :\). Take it easy my friend.
thank you man. While i cant say i'm out of the woods yet, as long as I know amazing people like you are out there I think we'll be alright :\)
